verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street clearly markets an employer-facing service. It plugs into People Ops, runs multiple cases in parallel with SLAs and status dashboards, designs the right visa from offer to start date, offers flat team-level pricing, and keeps audit-ready records. That shows the company side of sponsorship is a documented service. However, the evidence never mentions H-1B transfers, H-1B registrations, or LCA compliance; the documented visa content centres on O-1 and EB-1 pathways. Missing for 10: any explicit H-1B transfer or registration service, LCA filing and compliance support, a detailed list of the employer petition paperwork handled, and independent corroboration.
